summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine open-market share buyback transactions under its existing buyback programme announced 12 March 2026. The filing details daily purchases on 18-22 May 2026 totalling 2,458,291 ordinary shares at prices ranging from 331.3p to 345.0p per share, with all shares bought for cancellation. No tender offer, premium, recommendation, or advisor is mentioned. The transaction is a standard capital return programme, not a special situation requiring event-driven analysis. This is a foreign private issuer's routine disclosure under Rule 13a-16.
